slides.sub: South Africa needed a run a ball with six wickets in hand. India's last five overs, in numbers.
slides.alt: Cover card in India blue. Headline: 30 off 30. They got 22. South Africa needed a run a ball with six wickets in hand in the 2024 T20 World Cup final. Three stat tiles: South Africa 147 for 4 after 15 overs, 22 runs scored in overs 16 to 20, and 4 wickets lost in the last 4 overs.

slides.title: How *30 off 30* slipped away
slides.sub: Target 177. Need, balls left and required rate are recalculated after every phase.
slides.source: Overs 17–18 are shown together: the scorecard pins the score after 16 and after 18, not between them.
slides.alt: Chase ledger table. Target 177. After 15 overs South Africa were 147 for 4, needing 30 off 30 balls at 6.00 an over. Over 16: 4 runs, needing 26 off 24 at 6.50. Overs 17 and 18, bowled by Pandya and Bumrah: 6 runs and 2 wickets, needing 20 off 12 at 10.00. Over 19 by Arshdeep Singh: 4 runs, needing 16 off 6 at 16.00. Over 20 by Hardik Pandya: 8 runs and 2 wickets. South Africa finished 169 for 8. India won by 7 runs.

slides.title: The run rate fell off a *cliff*
slides.sub: South Africa's scoring rate, before and after the 15th over
slides.takeaway: From almost 10 an over to 4.4, with Klaasen gone at 16.1 and Miller at 19.1.
slides.source: Run rates computed from 147/4 after 15 overs and 169/8 final.
slides.alt: Two horizontal bars comparing South Africa's run rate. Overs 1 to 15: 147 runs at 9.80 per over, in green. Overs 16 to 20: 22 runs at 4.40 per over, in red, less than half as long. Klaasen was out at 16.1 overs and Miller at 19.1.

slides.title: India's bowlers, ranked by *economy*
slides.sub: The three who bowled the death overs went at 6.67 or less. Everyone else: 11+.
slides.alt: Leaderboard of India's bowlers ranked by economy rate. Jasprit Bumrah 4-0-18-2, economy 4.50. Arshdeep Singh 4-0-20-2, 5.00. Hardik Pandya 3-0-20-3, 6.67. Kuldeep Yadav 4-0-45-0, 11.25. Ravindra Jadeja 1-0-12-0, 12.00. Axar Patel 4-0-49-1, 12.25. The top three, who bowled the death overs, are highlighted.

slides.title: Heinrich Klaasen
highlights: 4 boundaries in a single Axar Patel over
Out first ball of the 17th: c Pant b Pandya
SA 151/5 when he fell: 26 needed off 23
slides.result: India 176/7 · South Africa 169/8 · India won by 7 runs
slides.alt: Player card in South Africa green for Heinrich Klaasen: 52 runs off 27 balls, 2 fours and 5 sixes, strike rate 192.6. 73% of his runs came in boundaries, 38 of 52. Highlights: four boundaries in a single Axar Patel over; out to the first ball of the 17th over, caught Pant bowled Pandya; South Africa were 151 for 5 when he fell, needing 26 off 23.

slides.title: Hardik Pandya
highlights: Defended 16 in the final over: gave 8
slides.result: Player of the match: Virat Kohli, 76 (59)
slides.alt: Player card in India blue for Hardik Pandya: 3 wickets for 20 runs in 3 overs, economy 6.67. He dismissed Klaasen at 16.1 overs, Miller at 19.1 and Rabada at 19.5, bowled the 17th and 20th overs, and defended 16 in the final over, conceding 8 with 2 wickets.

slides.title: Jasprit Bumrah
slides.result: Bumrah was also Player of the Tournament
slides.alt: Player card in India blue for Jasprit Bumrah: 4 overs, 18 runs, 2 wickets, economy 4.50, the best on either side; South Africa's best was Anrich Nortje at 6.50. He bowled Hendricks in the 2nd over and bowled Jansen at 17.4 overs when South Africa needed 21 off 14 balls.

thread.text:
30 off 30 with 6 wickets in hand. South Africa got 22.

The last five overs of the 2024 T20 World Cup final, rebuilt from the scorecard. #T20WorldCup

Three spells decided it:

- Klaasen 52 (27), out first ball of the 17th
- Hardik 3-20, defended 16 in the last over
- Bumrah 4-0-18-2, best economy on either side

Best death over you've ever watched? Reply with the match.

Data: official scorecard + fall of wickets (ESPNcricinfo, Wikipedia match page). Run rates, required rates and economies computed from those totals. Overs 17-18 shown together because the split isn't on the scorecard.
